    <p class="academic-summary">
      My research focuses on nonsmooth and nonconvex optimization, high-order Moreau and forward-backward envelopes, proximal algorithms, and variational analysis. I am particularly interested in convergence theory, inexact methods, and optimization techniques motivated by machine learning, inverse problems, and data science.
    </p>
